title: nVent Equity Research
summary: AI data-center electrification, operating forecasts and valuation for nVent Electric (NYSE: NVT).
question: How does AI infrastructure demand translate into nVent’s operating outlook and valuation?
takeaway: The report separates a constructive operating thesis from a more restrained valuation conclusion.
overview: An equity research report examining nVent’s role in AI data-center electrification, power management, cooling, and systems protection.
The June 2026 report develops an investment thesis, operating forecasts, valuation analysis, and a DCF cross-check. Dates and assumptions refer to the original document.

title: Sustainable Investing
summary: A survey of 35 studies on whether sustainable investing changes corporate behavior or mainly reprices assets.
question: Does sustainable investing change corporate behavior, or primarily reprice financial assets?
takeaway: Evidence for price effects is more consistent; engagement shows stronger evidence of operational change than unconditional exit.
overview: A coauthored survey of 35 theoretical and empirical studies examining sustainable investing through two links: its effect on financing costs, and the resulting effect on corporate behavior.

The paper compares divestment, ESG integration, and shareholder engagement. Written by Dipen Bhatt, Amanda Arthur, Shanshan Wang, and Hanbing Yang for Topics in Quantitative Finance at WashU Olin. The full paper includes its generative-AI disclosure.

title: Zero Energy Building
summary: Energy-efficient residential design, solar sizing and life-cycle costing for a household in Nepal.
question: How can efficient design and renewable energy reduce a Nepalese household’s energy needs?
takeaway: A residential feasibility study combining energy demand, renewable supply, building systems, and economic analysis.
overview: A civil engineering team project at Thapathali Campus, Tribhuvan University, investigating zero-energy residential building design in Nepal.

The report studies energy-efficient materials and appliances, geothermal heat-pump feasibility, solar-panel sizing, rainwater harvesting, solid-waste management, and economic analysis. Prepared by Devashish Singh, Devesh Gyawali, Dipen Bhatt, Garima Bhusal, Gaurav Basnet, and Ishwara Gautam.
